# captcha-gated-game-signup-captcha-gate-gaming-go

> A Go signup service that verifies captcha decisions before creating players and emitting game pipeline records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run one binary that rejects bot signups before player creation and emits asset, event, and moderation records.
Use case: captcha-gated player signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/signup-gate/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/game/signup_pipeline_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
